english.title: Proprietor or editor of tobacco advertisement published by means of an information society service

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: in the course of a business

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[proprietor of]_
(B)_[editor of information contained in]_

an information society service by means of which, provided in the course of a business, a tobacco advertisement was published in

(C)_[the United Kingdom]_
(D)_[an EEA State other than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..), by a service provider established in the United Kingdom]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3A(2)(a) and 16(2) of the Tobacco Advertising and Promotion Act 2002.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
